_readme: ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN — matches the game's default Xbox scheme
(Standard or Expert; both use the same buttons, only in-game stick
behaviour differs). No in-game rebinding needed.
AC7 flies on the LEFT stick (pitch + roll) with the camera on the right
stick, and throttle is split over the triggers: RT = accelerate,
LT = brake, both together = high-G turn.
So here: main stick X/Y -> left stick (roll/pitch, pull back to climb).
THROTTLE LEVER is split: forward half -> RT (accelerate), back half ->
LT (brake), centre detent = cruise. TWIST works the digital yaw
buttons: twist left = LB (yaw left), twist right = RB (yaw right).
Trigger = missile (B). Thumb FIRE = machine gun (A). C head = change
target (Y). B head = change weapon (X). A head = change view (RS).
PINKIE = flares (LS+RS pressed together). D = high-G (LT+RT together).
POV hat = radio replies. T1 = pause, T3 = map zoom.
